normalization.reason: The valid execution handoff predates the current result envelope and used as_of instead of completed_at. Findings are preserved without invention.

execution.method: public web fetch, read only, no contact and no form submission

findings.claim: Five KPI labels render on the homepage with no numeric value beside any of them: years of operating experience, thousand square metres managed, occasional contracts, satisfied clients, and subcontractors.
No client logos, testimonials, certifications or awards appear on the sampled homepage.
The site trades as Premier FM and Premier Facility Management Team while the contact page names Otthonbiztonsagban.hu Kft.; the relationship is not explained on the sampled page.
Lékó Péter is published as Értékesítési vezető, Sales Manager, with a direct business email and mobile number; Schmöltz Miklós is published as Facility Manager with direct contact details.
A quote call to action leads to a contact form and published general and direct contact routes; no response-time commitment was observed.
No social-media link appears on the sampled homepage; this is not proof that no social account exists.

limitations: Only the homepage and contact page were fetched in the execution.
The KPI render state was not tested across browsers or devices.
The Hungarian company register, reviews, maps, performance and mobile behavior were not checked.
Sales Manager is a verified role, not evidence of signing authority.
unknowns: The true KPI figures and whether their absence is a rendering fault or unpublished data.
The relationship between Premier FM and Otthonbiztonsagban.hu Kft.

route_test.reason: The strongest findings concern owned-site proof, brand-to-entity clarity and the quote journey.
